title: Rhodes Rain Over Croydon
description: A dreamier, soulful 2-step roller at 132 BPM led by an emotive felt-piano chord progression that swells over a swung breakbeat skeleton. Deep sub bass wobbles beneath shuffled, bitcrushed hats while the room opens and closes, building from a misty intro to a full nocturnal groove and back down.

    s("bd ~ ~ [~ bd]").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.85),
